components.name: Primary Field Link
components.description: The hero action that carries visitors from the event thesis into the build index.
components.css: .ds-primary-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); background: #ffffff; color: #131127; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .18s ease-out, background .18s ease-out; } .ds-primary-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #dce7ff; } .ds-primary-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4285f4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A square, practical survey field for searching the public project record.
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 15px; background: #f1f3ff; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { border-color: #4285f4; } .ds-search-icon { color: #505977; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; } .ds-search-field input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #131127; font: 14px Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field input::placeholder { color: #676b82; } .ds-search-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4285f4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Track Filter Chip
components.description: The system's only pill-shaped control, used to select a prize-track filter.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid #b9bfd6; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #32334a; font: 750 11px Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color: #131127; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4285f4; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #131127; background: #131127; color: #ffffff; }

components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 66px minmax(0,1fr) 180px; gap: 28px; padding: 34px 0 36px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(19,17,39,.2); background: #f1f3ff; color: #131127; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-project-number { padding-top: 8px; color: #6a6e87; font: 12px monospace; } .ds-project-row h3 { margin: 0; font: 660 clamp(27px,3vw,42px)/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-members { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #64677d; font-size: 12px; } .ds-summary { max-width: 780px; margin: 19px 0; color: #3f4055; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-track { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 9px; background: #dce4ff; color: #293d78; font: 650 9px monospace; } .ds-project-link { align-self: start; justify-self: end; display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #aeb5cd; color: #131127; font: 750 11px Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-project-link:hover { border-color: #131127; background: #ffffff; } .ds-project-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4285f4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Award Stamp
components.description: A small certification mark for a winner, colored by its assigned Gemini signal.
components.css: .ds-award-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #4285f4; color: #4285f4; font: 700 9px monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-3deg); }

components.name: Photo Ledger Slot
components.description: A composed documentary placeholder that remains intentional until event photography arrives.
components.css: .ds-photo-slot { position: relative; min-height: 220px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px dashed #8293c4; background: #dce4ff; color: #131127; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-photo-label { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 20px; left: 20px; font: 9px monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-photo-cross { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .45; background: linear-gradient(to top right,transparent calc(50% - .5px),#8793b8 50%,transparent calc(50% + .5px)),linear-gradient(to bottom right,transparent calc(50% - .5px),#8793b8 50%,transparent calc(50% + .5px)); } .ds-photo-slot figcaption { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; font: 700 20px Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-photo-slot figcaption span { font: 600 10px monospace; }

narrative.overview:
This is a public field record for a day of making, not a generic event landing page. Deep ink, cool survey paper, ruled indexes, orbital coordinates, stamped awards, and deliberately composed photo slots make the recap feel collected in the field and filed for later discovery. The visual language holds both the intensity of a build day and the sober usefulness of an archive.

The system is editorial and dense without becoming precious. Monumental Bricolage Grotesque headlines establish the event's scale; Noto Sans keeps descriptions readable; Roboto Mono turns dates, counts, tracks, and controls into instrument markings. Gemini's primary colors appear as scarce navigational signals, award identifiers, and track accents rather than an all-over rainbow.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-ink editorial panels set against cool, lightly blue paper.
Ruled records, numbers, coordinates, and labels make discovery feel indexed.
Gemini primaries identify meaningful states and award tracks.
Crisp rectangular containers are the default; the filter chip is the intentional exception.
Photography placeholders are designed ledger entries, never empty image boxes.

rules.name: The Four-Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue, red, yellow, and green identify four distinct awards or tracks; do not collapse them into decoration or introduce competing saturated accents.

rules.name: The Ink-First Rule
rules.body: Let Field Ink and Survey Paper carry the page's visual weight. Saturation is a locator, not a background strategy.

rules.name: The Index Voice Rule
rules.body: Counts, times, coordinates, filters, tracks, and award annotations use the mono voice so the display face stays reserved for human-readable statements and names.

rules.name: The Ruled-Record Rule
rules.body: Project entries, facts, and winners are organized by top and bottom rules, not detached card grids. Keep the scan line visible across the record.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Do not put generic shadows beneath project entries, photos, or winner rows. A rule and a tonal field are the default separators.

dos: Do lead hero and section moments with the display face, then return to Noto Sans for explanatory copy.
Do use mono for field metadata, including numbers, date lines, project tracks, result counts, and award labels.
Do preserve the square, ruled entry system for lists and records.
Do use the Gemini color set to differentiate confirmed track or winner states.
Do treat photo replacements as content inserted into the established ledger composition.
donts: Don't replace the project index with a generic rounded card grid.
Don't use Gemini primaries as broad decorative background fills outside their established signal roles.
Don't add soft rounded corners to ordinary actions, entries, fields, or photo frames; only category filters are pill-shaped.
Don't turn the image placeholders into blank boxes or remove their field labels before photography is ready.
Don't add shadows to every container; the record stays flat unless a control or hero marker needs to float.
